items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1962-09-19
items.q: They don't have nothing I made with Ella Fitzgerald.

ctx.x: Haven't you any plans for issuing an album?
Well, I just made several albums. They are out yet? Yeah, they're not over here. They don't have nothing I made with Ella Fitzgerald.
Yes, that one, but the life story, like the Crosby life story.
